earnings.title: Nutanix Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
highlights: GAAP Operating Income $70.0 million $31.2 million $38.8 million
Reports 16% YoY ARR Growth and Strong Free Cash Flow for Fiscal 2026

quotes.text: Our fourth quarter was a strong finish to fiscal 2026, a year in which we delivered solid top and bottom line performance and added over 3,000 new customers.
Our fiscal 2026 results demonstrated a good balance of top and bottom line performance with 16% year-over-year ARR growth and strong free cash flow generation.
